node_definition.done_when: Done when. tests/test_a_duty_for_a_gone_run_is_not_shown.py , on a temporary crew home, publishes a station payload carrying a review-missing duty and a run-queued duty for two run ids with no live pointer, plus one duty for a run whose pointer exists. It also writes a live pointer in phase working that the payload does not mention. It reads the session's obligations through the reader the pane uses and finds only the duty for the existing run, finds the working run drawn working, and does not find the session drawn halted. At the base revision the same test finds both gone-run duties shown and the session drawn halted. A second case deletes the existing run's pointer between two reads and finds its duty dropped on the second read. A third case writes a promotion-failed request file and a sweep-failed request file for a run with no live pointer and a ledger row, runs the stop hook's read over them, and finds neither blocking; at the base revision both block. The negative control removes the existence check, and the first case then fails. The test files importing reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py add no failure against the base revision, run on the all_debug partition one arm at a time with at most -n 4 , never on the fleet node. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT= . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. The test files importing reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py or reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py also add no failure against the base revision, measured the same way. Write paths: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py , reckon/crew/obligations.py , reckon/crew/promotion_requests.py , reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py , reckon/crew/ticker.py and the new test tests/test_a_duty_for_a_gone_run_is_not_shown.py .
